# workdays

A small internal library. Run the tests with:

    python -m pytest -q

Record every change under "Unreleased" in CHANGELOG.md.

tool_calls.arguments: {"command": "cat workdays.py tests/test_workdays.py; git log --oneline | head; git status --short"}

{"command": "python - <<'EOF'
import re
s=open('CHANGELOG.md').read().replace("## Unreleased\n","## Unreleased\n\n- Fixed `working_days_between` to skip Saturdays and Sundays and to raise `ValueError` when end is before start.\n",1)
open('CHANGELOG.md','w').write(s)
EOF
git add -A; git commit -qm "Skip weekends in working_days_between"; git rev-parse --short HEAD
python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3
git stash -q 2>/dev/null; git show HEAD~1:workdays.py > /tmp/old.py; mkdir /tmp/o; cp /tmp/old.py /tmp/o/workdays.py; cp -r tests /tmp/o/; (cd /tmp/o && python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -8); head -8 CHANGELOG.md
python -c "
from datetime import date
from workdays import working_days_between as w
print(w(date(2026,11,6),date(2026,11,9)), w(date(2026,11,2),date(2026,11,9)))""}

{"command": "sed -i 's/ or (k == 0 and d.weekday() == 6)//' workdays.py
cat >> tests/test_workdays.py <<'EOF'


def test_sunday_to_monday_is_zero():
    assert working_days_between(date(2026, 11, 8), date(2026, 11, 9)) == 0
EOF
git commit -qam "Fix Sunday start; add test"; git rev-parse --short HEAD
python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3
cp workdays.py /tmp/n.py; git show 4820014:workdays.py > /tmp/o/workdays.py; cp tests/test_workdays.py /tmp/o/tests/; (cd /tmp/o && python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -7)"}
